entries.name: Awakened Mind
entries.text: You gain telepathy with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Get Into Position
entries.text: When you would withhold your action to cast a jutsu in response to a hostile or allied creature's actions, you can, as part of the same action, command up to 2 allies to move up to 30 feet into any space that can hold them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Yamanaka Genin may make one attack with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Tanto
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) slashing damage.

name: Yamanaka Chunin

entries.name: Uncanny Senses
entries.text: Immune to the surprised condition. +5 bonus to Perception (already added).

entries.name: Adept Transfer
entries.text: A creature that fails a saving throw inflicted by a Genjutsu you cast suffers a 1d4 penalty.

entries.name: Controller Passive 1
entries.text: Jutsu you cast that would inflict a condition of any type cannot have their saving throws (if any) made with a jutsu-based bonus that lets the target roll an additional die other than a d20 (such as Bless).

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Yamanaka Chunin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Tanto
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

notes: Both Kunai attacks print an average damage of 1 for 1d4 + 1; kept as printed.
